title: 第二十三章 热闹前夕第二十四章 热闹的活动
content_zh:
当天夜晚，高山村的几个老头子连带着那些青壮年，一个个的则是坐在了酒店的那一层，包了最大的包间才能让这些壮汉坐下。
这些人可不比其他人。
相比于在城市里生活，在农村里生活的这些老实人，高山村的这些壮汉一个个的都有一种没有经过知识渲染的野性美。
大字都不认识几个，知识最渊博的还得是那几个老头子，年轻人没几个愿意动脑子的，有什么事老头子商议完上去抡起拳头就是干。
也正是因为如此，在跟他们有过接触之后的酒店经理面对高山村的这些人，那也是小心翼翼，生怕哪里惹到这些爷。
于是乎，哪怕是同样都来参与这海城庆典活动的其他人，在待遇上也没有高山村的这些人待遇好。
就算是同样的待遇，高山村这些人也有一些隐性显性的好处。
其他人倒也是有些看不惯的。
然而甭管再怎么看不惯，百十个青壮手持刀枪身穿铠甲，一个个的拳头比大腿还粗，有几个人敢往上面凑？
若不是这一个酒店是海城特地包下来的酒店，说不定这些人每一次出行还得有人特地监督呢。
这可是几十号人的壮汉。
就只是看这些人一个个提刀拿枪的样子就知道不是好惹的，手中的弓箭那是真的能惹出大麻烦。
再加上现如今今时不同往日，高山村的人确实是得到大好处，寻常人还真不敢在他们面前胡说什么。
随时能拉起百十号青壮来。
这实力已经相当强了！
凭啥赵总对待宋风，对待另外五个老头子如此的认真，甚至时不时的还冒冒头展现一下双方的关系？
没别的，主要是这些人真闹起来绝对是个大乱子，山上这些人就是不稳定因素啊。
算上宋风，六个老头坐在最上边。
此刻六个老头看着下面一个个的喝酒划拳，大口吃肉，大口啃馒头的那些年轻人，脸上也都露出几分笑容。
高山村的日子苦啊。

那深山老林百十里，在过去那种经济不发达科技没发展过的时代，就算是有着万人大军扑进去估计也就只能冒个泡。
当年战争的时候都没让异族找到。
由此也能知道他们的位置究竟是多深，藏的多好了。
但也正是因为如此，村子里面的村民也只能吃个半饱，大部分时间都是吃些野菜，活倒是能活着，但是不至于像现在一样大口吃肉，大口喝酒。
往上数十几代老祖宗，真是没有一个人能有他们这些人过的舒服的。
几个老头一个个的看着年轻人吃喝高兴，但是也只能吃点萝卜白菜，啃点馒头土豆了。
年纪大了身体有些受不了。
以前的时候身体没有油水，年轻人啃上两次肥肉拉拉肚子就完了，但是像他们这些老家伙顶多就是尝尝味儿，再吃多了小命说不定就没了。
而就在这几个吃着萝卜咸菜，看着底下壮汉露出笑脸的时候，宋风这大口吃肉，大口吃鱼的身影在六个老头之中，别提是多么显眼了。
尤其是他面前那大猪肘子。
content_en:
That night, several old men from Gaoshan Village, together with the young and middle-aged men, sat on the floor of the hotel one by one. They reserved the largest private rooms so that these strong men could sit down.
These people are no better than others.
Compared with the honest people living in cities and rural areas, these strong men in the mountain villages all have a wild beauty that has not been exaggerated by knowledge.
I don't even know a few of them, and the most knowledgeable ones are the old men. Few young people are willing to use their brains. If there is something, the old men will go up and raise their fists after discussing something.
It is precisely because of this that the hotel manager who has had contact with them is also cautious when facing these people in Gaoshan Village, for fear of offending these people.
As a result, even the other people who also came to participate in the Haicheng celebrations were not treated as well as the people in Gaoshan Village.
Even with the same treatment, these people in Gaoshan Village still have some implicit and explicit benefits.
Others can't stand it either.
However, no matter how hard you look at it, there are hundreds of young men holding swords and guns and wearing armor, and their fists are thicker than their thighs. How many people dare to get up there?
If this hotel hadn't been specially chartered by Haicheng, maybe someone would have to supervise these people every time they travel.
This is a strong man numbering dozens of people.
Just by looking at the way these people were holding knives and guns, I knew they were not easy to mess with. The bows and arrows in their hands could really cause big trouble.
In addition, today is different from the past. The people in Gaoshan Village have indeed received great benefits. Ordinary people really don't dare to say nonsense in front of them.
You can pull up No. 100 young men at any time.
This strength is already quite strong!
Why does Mr. Zhao treat Song Feng and the other five old men so seriously, and even show off their relationship from time to time?
Nothing else, the main thing is that these people will definitely cause a big mess if they really make trouble. These people on the mountain are a factor of instability.
Counting Song Feng, six old men sat at the top.
At this moment, the six old men looked at the young people below who were drinking, punching, eating meat, and nibbling steamed buns, with a little smile on their faces.
Life in Gaoshan Village is hard.
The deep mountains and old forests are hundreds of miles away. In the past era when the economy was underdeveloped and technology had not developed, even if an army of ten thousand people rushed in, it would probably only be a bubble.
During the war, the aliens were not found.
From this we can also know how deep their position is and how well hidden they are.
But it is precisely because of this that the villagers in the village can only eat half full, and eat wild vegetables most of the time. They can survive, but they will not eat as much meat and drink as they do now.
For dozens of generations of ancestors, no one could live as comfortably as they did.
Several old men watched the young people eating and drinking happily, but they could only eat some radish, cabbage, and nibble some steamed buns and potatoes.
As I get older, my body can't handle it.
In the past, there was no fat in the body, and young people would end up with diarrhea after eating fat meat twice. But old guys like them could only taste it, and they might die if they ate too much.
And while these few were eating carrots and pickles and looking at the smiling faces of the strong men below, Song Feng, who was eating meat and fish, was very conspicuous among the six old men.
Especially the big pig's knuckle in front of him.
